key.name: show-indicator
key.summary: Show indicator in the top bar
key.description: Whether to show the extension's Night Light toggle in the top bar. While shown, the native GNOME Night Light top bar icon is hidden so that only one Night Light indicator is visible. When disabled the native icon is left untouched.

key.name: restore-state
key.summary: Restore the previous Night Light configuration on disable
key.description: When enabled, the extension remembers the values of the GNOME Night Light settings it changes while toggling and restores them when the extension is disabled. Values that were changed again afterwards are not overwritten. When disabled, the changes made by the extension are kept when the extension is disabled.
